race.comment: ON DASHER (10) opened his career in the best possible manner last start, drawing wide on the back row before working to the front and cruising home by close to 40m as a hot favourite at Penrith. Has to contend with a very wide draw but looks a talent. COCOS DESIRE (9) did a good job when resuming from a back row draw in a Breeders Challenge heat at Newcastle, beaten 2.7 metres. Draws wide but has won second-up before so should be improved. MYRTLE MAY (4) only missed narrowly as runner-up at this circuit and distance last time. Could go one better. WILLS WAY (6) must be considered after coming from wider draws to place in his last two outings here.
